scene: The brass key unlocks the transit foyer doors.
picture: A flat side view of the aquarium transit foyer along polished stone. Up high, a moored brass airship waits beside an open boarding hatch. Left, a yellow robot delivery truck idles with ramp down. Centre, the player in her purple wheelchair holds a brass key. Far right, a pink-striped steam train puffs vapour.
